judgments.reason: The rules state the winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives the three-coin commission (commission is awarded after payment). The model_articulation does not claim or explain a mechanism where the commission is applied before payment to allow over-bidding, so this hypothesis is incorrect and not demonstrated.

The game text shows the clerk reveals committed rival bids in feedback, but the model_articulation never explicitly articulates the mechanism that waiting reveals already-committed sealed rival bids before you commit. The specification is true in the spec, but the model did not articulate that mechanism, so it is not a demonstrated discovery.

The specification claims 'close' settles even with unauctioned lots, but the rule text says '[close: 1] settles after all three lots are sold.' That contradicts the hypothesis, and the model_articulation does not support it, so it is incorrect and not discovered.

There is no rule stating catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission; catalog items are explicitly 'not auction wins.' The model_articulation does not assert such a mechanism, so the hypothesis is false and not demonstrated.
